full_judgment: 5. Against the aforesaid judgment and order of reversal dated 21.07.2003, the plaintiff as petitioner preferred Civil Revision No.42 of 2004 before the High Court Division and the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division issued Rule and upon hearing both sides the Rule was made absolute.
